svg.title: TFA actions and table axes
svg.desc: Four inputs feed estimate-tfa: contig by sample abundance, function by contig inventory, taxon names, and taxon to contig mapping. The sparse TFA output has taxon-function pair rows and sample columns. Selecting a taxon yields function by sample tables; collapsing samples yields a taxon by function table; selecting a function yields taxon by sample tables. Example numbers match the action tests.
svg.text: Concrete example from the action tests · each number is a table value
Sparse rows = (taxon, function) pairs · columns = original samples
All three downstream actions are optional. Collapse choices: sum (shown), mean, median.
